thread:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — doing a final pass on the launch posts this afternoon. Need quick calls on keyword anchors, schema snippets, and a minimal redirect fallback for legacy campaign URLs. Can we triage in-thread?
Tom Rivera: Sounds good. Main constraints? traffic priority pages vs longtail blog posts?
Aisha Patel: Priority = benchmark narrative post, webinar landing, and two how-to posts. Longtail can be queued.
Lara Chen: For schema: we should add Article + FAQ + Event (for the webinar). I'll draft JSON-LD snippets and share. Keep FAQ short to avoid duplicate content.
Ben Ortiz: Redirects: legacy campaign URLs are like /lp/redwood-ai-2023 and /campaigns/seed. Proposal: 301 to canonical with UTM stripped, keep a /legacy redirect map for 90 days then blanket 302 -> /resources if not matched.
Tom Rivera: Agree 301 for matched redirects. For unmatched, prefer a useful landing vs 302 -> resources. 302 might confuse crawlers.
Aisha Patel: @Ben can you drop the map snippet here? Also we need anchor text plan for internal linking from product pages to benchmark narrative. Short anchors vs phrase anchors?
Ben Ortiz: Map snippet: ```
# redirects.csv
old_path,new_path,type
/lp/redwood-ai-2023,/launch/benchmark-narrative,301
/campaigns/seed,/resources/seed-guide,301
/blog/untitled-post,/blog/2026/updated-post,301
```
Lara Chen: Anchor strategy: use 2-layer anchors — exact intent anchors on product pages (e.g., "benchmarking LLM inference") and long-form anchors in blog grid (e.g., "cost, latency, and reliability benchmarks for inference"). That balances anchor diversity.
Tom Rivera: Also add schema for the benchmark page: meta reviewRating? We don't have star ratings but we can include "reviewedBy" and an aggregateRating object with type: "AggregateRating" and count = test runs. Keeps it structured without fake stars.
Aisha Patel: Good call. For internal linking priorities: 1) benchmark narrative from product overview, 2) webinar landing from docs/how-to, 3) CTA in benchmark post linking to Dedicated trial.
Lara Chen: Webinar Event JSON-LD quick draft (will expand): ```{
"@context":"https://schema.org",
"@type":"Event",
"name":"Redwood inference benchmarks webinar",
"startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00-07:00",
"location":{
  "@type":"VirtualLocation",
  "url":"https://redwood.example/webinar/benchmarks"
}
}```
Ben Ortiz: Redirect edge cases: We need canonical headers on old pages during redirect rollout to avoid split signals. Also add rel=canonical on new canonical pages pointing to themselves.
Tom Rivera: Tracking: strip utm on redirect but capture original utm_campaign into GA via landing param ?orig_campaign, then server-side record, then redirect cleanly. avoids long UTM chains.
Aisha Patel: Action items: Lara - post final JSON-LD for benchmark + webinar + FAQ by EOD. Ben - push redirects.csv to staging and QA the 301s by 4pm. Tom - update internal linking plan doc and add example anchor list. I'll review and merge.
seo-bot: Reminder: sitemap update queued after redirects go live; submit to Search Console once staging verifies 200s on canonical. :checkered_flag:
Lara Chen: Will do. Quick Q: canonicalization for translated posts — keep language paths (/en/, /fr/) with hreflang?
Tom Rivera: Yes, keep language-coded canonical + hreflang linking. For small translations, consider x-default to English.
Aisha Patel: Thanks team. If nothing else, we’ll ship the redirect map + schema and call it done. Ping here when staging PR is ready. :thumbsup:
